profile.description: Repo profile: picks which canon verbatim files get synced.

with.description: Opt-in canon groups. "renovate" is deprecated and does nothing: Renovate is the canon's dependency bot for every profile.

exceptions.description: An exception holds its item back in both `stack check` (the finding is suppressed and reported as allowed) and `stack sync` (the item is left untouched). Each exception addresses exactly one canon file or exactly one catalog entry.
